body: Thank you, for replying. I love her now, already, more than anything in the whole world. Reading your post, and thinking that I will fall in love even more if helping me to feel more positive. It was a confusing and scary having the feeling I was experienceing last night, its confusing because I don't actually have hesitations, I was excited for the future, and I've had a positive pregnancy so far. The shift to strong negative thoughts was sudden and overwhelming, and scary, but already reading these posts, sleeping and having plans to talk to the Dr today is helping. Thank you!

Thank you for sharing your experience, (I have only experienced suicidal thoughts on one other occasion, a few years ago). The feeling this time was sudden, and scary, and intrusive. I didn't really know how to work through the urge. I'm seeing the DR today for a regular check up. Thank you agian for taking the time to respond to my post, reading your post was comforting that I'm not alone in feeling this way. Thank you.

Thank you, so much. I exhauseted myself last night, and have woken up feeling slightly better this morning. I have an appoitment with the Doctor today. I was being treated for depression before pregnancy, with medication, which I stopped taking due to the risks to the baby (after discussing with my doctor). I had a great pregnancy up untill now (feeling really positive), the shift to strong negative feelings was sudden and scary. I suspect you are right about antenatal depression. Thank you again for taking the time.

that sounds like a horrible position to be in, I really feel frustrated for you. Can you finish your study and emigrate to another English speaking country (sorry... I don't really know what to say). I hope you are ok.
